name: antigravity-monitor
description: Live context-window, quota, and model telemetry for Antigravity conversations in the desktop app, Antigravity IDE, and VS Code.

antigravityMonitor.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often to check Antigravity for conversation changes, in milliseconds. Trajectory contents are only re-read when a change is detected.

antigravityMonitor.warningThreshold.markdownDescription: Context usage percentage at or above which the status bar switches to the warning colour. Set to 100 to disable the warning.

antigravityMonitor.showQuota.markdownDescription: Show the active model's remaining quota next to the context usage in the status bar.

antigravityMonitor.maskPersonalInfo.markdownDescription: Mask the account name and e-mail address in the hover tooltip and dashboard.

antigravityMonitor.quotaWarningThreshold.markdownDescription: Warn when the remaining quota of the model in use falls to this percentage. Set to 0 to disable the warning.

enumDescriptions: Percentage only, on the status bar and the inline badge.
Choose context, remaining tokens, 5-hour quota, weekly quota, model, and reset fields.
antigravityMonitor.displayMode.markdownDescription: How much detail the always-visible surfaces show. Tooltips and the dashboard stay detailed in either mode.

antigravityMonitor.maxPayloadMb.markdownDescription: Maximum response size, in megabytes, accepted from the Antigravity backend. Oversized conversations are reported as unmeasurable rather than parsed.

antigravityMonitor.snippetContext.markdownDescription: Include context used in Custom snippet mode.

antigravityMonitor.snippetRemaining.markdownDescription: Include remaining context in Custom snippet mode.

antigravityMonitor.snippetFiveHour.markdownDescription: Include the selected model group's live 5-hour quota in Custom snippet mode.

antigravityMonitor.snippetWeekly.markdownDescription: Include the selected model group's live weekly quota in Custom snippet mode.

antigravityMonitor.snippetModel.markdownDescription: Include the model name in Custom snippet mode.

antigravityMonitor.snippetResets.markdownDescription: Append reset countdowns to selected quota fields in Custom snippet mode.
